newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares close at record, index above 1000 pts.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares close at record, index above 1000 pts.

text.p: Dutch shares jumped to a new record close above 1,000 points on Thursday, despite a fall of index heavyweight Royal Dutch which announced disappointing second quarter results, dealers said.

The AEX share index closed 18.08 points higher at 1010.97 points and dealers said they saw little reason for the strong rise today. "There is a lot of liquidity around and the rate hike worries faded, but the strong rise was somewhat unexpected," the dealer said.
He added that investors were looking for firms that were expected to announce strong half-year profits in the near-term.
Royal Dutch, which announced disappointing second quarter results this morning, fell 2.30 guilders to 117.90. The stock hit a day's low at 114.20.

Financials were among the rising stocks, after rate hike worries started to ebb. ABN AMRO gained 2.30 guilders or 4.7 percent to 51.20 guilders. Fortis Amev rose just over four percent or 3.80 guilders to 95.00.
Music and entertainment firm Polygram strongly outperformed the market today, but closed off its earlier peak. It closed 5.40 guilders higher at 125.40 after touching a high of 129.80 earlier.
Polygram has risen 24 guilders in just over a week.
"Overdone," said one dealer, while another noted it was moving up on old news as Motown restructuring was already known.
Dealers had been watching the central bank's announcement on the new special advances pact at 1400 GMT, but the advances rate remained unchanged at 3.00 percent.
Paper and office equipment group KNP BT rose 2.40 to 50.10, as analysts were more upbeat on the stock after last week's announced that its business had picked up in the second quarter of 1997.
